I-tenant.en: Derive tenant and subject from the verified session. Enforce current tenant/ACL filters before retrieval and check current access again when a citation is opened. Never share content across tenants.
I-tenant.zh: 从已验证会话确定租户与主体。检索前执行当前 tenant/ACL 过滤，打开引用时再次核对当前权限；租户之间不共享内容。

I-approval.en: Approval binds tenant, subject, tool, canonical-parameter SHA-256 hash, expiry and idempotency key. Approval is a stored record, not model text. Reauthorize immediately before execution; reject stale, modified or cross-tenant requests.
I-approval.zh: 审批绑定租户、主体、工具、规范参数 SHA-256 hash、有效期与幂等键。审批是持久记录而非模型文本；执行前重新授权，拒绝过期、篡改或跨租户请求。

I-authority.en: Model output, retrieved documents and guardrails never grant authority. Guardrails filter content; deterministic BFF and gateway checks enforce permissions.
I-authority.zh: 模型输出、检索文档和 guardrails 均不授予权限。Guardrails 过滤内容，BFF 与网关的确定性检查执行权限控制。

I-delegation.en: The BFF is the confidential OIDC client (authorization code + PKCE; verifier stays server-side). The Agent Service is the authenticated token-exchange client. The enterprise AS must explicitly support the required constrained delegation (RFC 8693); this is an assumption, not a generic IdP promise.
I-delegation.zh: BFF 是机密 OIDC 客户端（授权码 + PKCE；verifier 保留在服务端）。Agent 服务是已认证的 token exchange 客户端。企业 AS 必须明确支持所需的受限委托（RFC 8693）；这是前提，不是任意 IdP 的通用能力。

I-tokens.en: AS issues BFF access token aud=application-api, sub=employee, and a downscoped agent subject token aud=agent-service. Agent exchanges only that valid subject token, authenticating as agent-client; AS issues tool token iss=enterprise-as, aud=mcp-tool-gateway, sub=employee, act=agent-client, tenant, permitted scopes and short expiry. Tools verifies signature/issuer/audience/expiry, delegation actor, tenant and current policy; reject before Service Desk on any mismatch. Tokens for Service Desk are separate scoped connector credentials, never forwarded model or BFF tokens.
I-tokens.zh: AS 签发 BFF access token（aud=application-api、sub=员工）及缩权的 agent 主体 token（aud=agent-service）。Agent 以 agent-client 身份认证，仅交换此有效主体 token；AS 签发工具 token：iss=enterprise-as、aud=mcp-tool-gateway、sub=员工、act=agent-client、tenant、许可 scopes 与短有效期。网关核验签名、issuer、audience、有效期、委托 actor、tenant 与当前策略；任一不符在工单调用前拒绝。工单使用独立受限连接器凭据，绝不转发模型或 BFF token。

I-idempotency.en: Persist execution intent and idempotency key before sending. Service Desk is assumed to support idempotent ticket creation by that key. After ambiguous timeouts reconcile by key; never blindly repeat a non-idempotent write.
I-idempotency.zh: 发送前持久化执行意图与幂等键。假设工单服务支持按该键幂等创建；超时结果不明时按键对账，绝不盲重试非幂等写入。

I-ingest.en: Version documents with source ACLs; retries are bounded and failures go to DLQ. Only completely indexed versions become searchable; revocation/tombstone updates invalidate search and citation access.
I-ingest.zh: 文档版本携带源 ACL；重试有界、失败进入 DLQ；完整索引的版本才可检索，撤权或删除同步失效检索与引用访问。

I-eval.en: Feedback starts in DS-app. A steward approves deidentified/synthetic export to DS-eval. Offline C-eval uses an evaluation-only identity and versioned prompt/model/dataset; no production tool writes. Gate promotions on quality, safety, latency and token-cost measures without claiming measured scores.
I-eval.zh: 反馈先存 DS-app。管理员批准去标识或合成数据导出至 DS-eval。离线 C-eval 使用评测专用身份及版本化 prompt/model/dataset，不可写生产工具；按质量、安全、延迟与 token 成本门禁晋级，不声称实测分数。

I-operator.en: Operators see service health and redacted telemetry, not tenant content by default. Logs omit raw tokens and document text. Admin changes are audited and do not bypass data-plane checks.
I-operator.zh: 运维默认只见服务健康与脱敏遥测，不获得租户内容权限。日志不含原始 token 与文档正文；管理变更审计且不绕过数据面检查。

I-bounds.en: Exactly three tools: catalogue.lookup, ticket.read, ticket.create. Write requests require the initiating employee approval within current permissions. No arbitrary scripts, procurement, autonomous refunds or unbounded agent loops.
I-bounds.zh: 仅三种工具：catalogue.lookup、ticket.read、ticket.create。写请求要求发起员工在当前权限内审批；无任意脚本、采购、自主退款或无限循环。

deployment.status: proposed teaching allocation; service availability and quotas must be checked before implementation
deployment.region: one supported AWS region, selected at implementation time; no cross-region model routing assumed

placement.C-web: S3 static origin + global CloudFront; executes in employee browser
placement.C-api: ECS Fargate desired >=2, one healthy task per AZ behind regional ALB
placement.C-agent: ECS Fargate desired >=2 across two AZs; internal HTTPS
placement.C-tools: ECS Fargate desired >=2 across two AZs; separate service identity
placement.C-ingest: ECS Fargate workers scheduled in either AZ from Q-ingest; idempotent version jobs
placement.C-eval: ECS Fargate scheduled task in either AZ; isolated evaluation IAM identity

stores.DS-app: Aurora PostgreSQL writer in one AZ, reader in other AZ; cluster storage across three AZs is service-managed, not a claim of three application AZs
stores.DS-index: OpenSearch provisioned domain, zone awareness across two AZs with replicas; not the distinct three-AZ Multi-AZ with Standby mode
stores.DS-doc: S3 regional versioned bucket outside customer subnets
stores.DS-eval: Separate S3 regional bucket/prefix policy, evaluation identity only
stores.Q-ingest: SQS regional queue and DLQ outside customer subnets

managed_services: Amazon Bedrock regional model endpoint outside customer subnets
CloudWatch regional redacted telemetry and cost measures
Secrets Manager regional scoped connector credentials

assumptionStatus.en: All additions below are illustrative teaching choices, not observations or deployment guarantees. Validate the selected AWS region, service support and external contracts before implementation.
assumptionStatus.zh: 以下补充均为教学示意选择，不是实测事实或部署保证；实施前须核对 AWS 区域、服务支持与外部接口契约。

summary.en: Application API is the ingestion-job producer; workers consume and publish indexed versions.
summary.zh: Application API 是摄取任务生产者；工作进程消费任务并发布索引版本。

details.trigger: steward requests import or source-version rescan through C-api
details.workerPublication: DS-doc and DS-index only, not new Q-ingest jobs
details.retry: SQS visibility 300s; maxReceiveCount 3; failed jobs to DLQ, replay only after cause fixed
details.revocation: deny at retrieval and citation immediately using current policy; asynchronously tombstone derived index within 60s

summary.en: One persisted request lifecycle; bind short-lived approval and reconcile uncertain writes before closure.
summary.zh: 单一持久请求生命周期；绑定短期审批，不确定写入须先对账再关闭。

details.keyReuse: same key and canonical hash returns prior outcome; a changed hash is rejected
details.reconciliation: read-only lookup by key every 30s, at most four automatic attempts; then hold outcome_unknown for operator-coordinated investigation without tenant-content access
details.closure: only outcome_recorded or refused may close; never close unknown as success or issue a fresh blind write

summary.en: Explicit role grants are unioned, then intersected with current tenant/resource constraints; policy denial wins.
summary.zh: 显式角色授权取并集，再与当前租户/资源约束相交；策略拒绝优先。

details.roleAssignment: server-verified current membership, never client-selected tenant/roles
details.default: deny absent grant or on evaluation error
employee: read own-tenant knowledge only if current ACL allows
create ticket only for own permitted draft with exact bound approval and execution-time reauthorization
steward: read own-tenant content only with current ACL
approve tenant-authorized deidentified or synthetic feedback export
operator: network/release operations using scoped automation identities
no implicit tenant-content or production tool-write grant
details.roleCombination: operator+employee may use separately granted employee rights; operator role contributes no content grant
details.serviceRule: AS proof and scopes are necessary, never sufficient; current policy, tenant, subject, actor and bound approval still apply

summary.en: Use the existing three human roles, with one accountable role per scoped activity.
summary.zh: 沿用三个既有人员角色，每项明确范围的活动设一个最终负责角色。

details.A: accountable for outcome and explicit human approval where required; never a data-plane permission grant
details.C: consult before a consequential change; not an approval bypass
details.scope: employee approval is per initiating employee; stewardship is per tenant; release approval covers the evaluated configuration, not arbitrary production data access

summary.en: Single-region, two-AZ network with TLS, explicit return routing and narrowly scoped endpoint/egress rules.
summary.zh: 单区域双 AZ 网络；TLS、显式返回路由与受限端点/出站规则。

details.addresses: RFC5737 documentation-only fixture; replace with an approved RFC1918 deployment plan before provisioning
details.ingress: browser HTTPS/443 through CloudFront to public ALB; origin accepts CloudFront origin-facing prefix list plus an origin secret header held only by platform automation; ALB targets C-api on TLS/443
details.eastWest: C-api→C-agent, C-agent→C-tools and C-tools→C-api on TLS/443 with workload mTLS; SG allowlists by service identity/security group
details.data: Aurora TCP/5432 only from API-approved application security groups; OpenSearch TLS/443 only Agent/Ingestion groups
details.privateEndpoints: S3 gateway endpoint; interface endpoints for SQS, Bedrock runtime, CloudWatch Logs, KMS and Secrets Manager; endpoint policies restrict roles/resources
details.externalEgress: one NAT gateway per AZ; application route uses same-AZ NAT, public route IGW; return path through same NAT with stateful SG and matching ephemeral NACL returns
details.externalFilters: HTTPS/443 to configured AS, Service Desk and source-repository address allowlists; placeholder endpoints use reserved .example names; NAT itself is not an authorizer or domain firewall
details.dns: VPC resolver + private DNS for interface endpoints; public/enterprise resolution for approved external .example fixtures replaced during deployment
details.noInbound: tasks/stores have no public addresses; no unsolicited inbound path; no peering/transit inferred

summary.en: Promote a tested versioned configuration bundle through human approval and scoped release automation.
summary.zh: 经人工批准和受限发布自动化，晋级已测试的版本化配置包。

details.trigger: pull request changing prompt/model configuration; repository workflow builds an immutable bundle in DS-eval
details.platform: illustrative GitHub Actions workflow with short-lived AWS workload federation, restricted repository/environment trust
details.evaluation: C-eval evaluates synthetic/deidentified holdout data using evaluation-only IAM identity; never writes production tools
details.approval: R-steward approves the exact evaluated digest; R-operator executes the release workflow
details.promotion: same digest to staging smoke, then production 5% traffic for 10min, then 100% if health gates pass; no rebuild between stages
details.enforcement: workflow deployment IAM role can update the configuration pointer only; C-eval cannot assume it
details.recovery: stop canary and restore previous compatible pointer on health regression; no automatic database rollback; incompatible changes require forward-fix plan and renewed approval
details.healthGate: 5xx below 2% and p95 <=8s during canary; minimum 100 requests or hold for manual review
details.scores: thresholds are illustrative, not measured outcomes or promised performance

summary.en: Measure scoped health and cost, redact before export, and route actionable alerts to operators.
summary.zh: 度量明确范围的健康与成本，在导出前脱敏，将可操作告警发送给运维。

details.SLI: successful authorized answer requests / eligible requests; exclude policy-denied requests from service-failure numerator, but count them separately for security monitoring
details.SLO: 99.5% successful authorized answers over rolling 30 days; illustrative internal target, not an SLA
details.latency: p95 end-to-end authorized answer latency <=8s, measured daily
details.cost: mean answer token cost <=USD0.02; warn when daily aggregate token cost exceeds USD20
details.capture: 100% aggregate metrics, 100% security/audit events; traces sampled at 10%; trace/context IDs join runtime hops without carrying raw content
details.redaction: remove raw tokens, prompts and document text before emission; pseudonymize tenant/user identifiers
details.route: CloudWatch alarms → SNS email → R-operator; acknowledge within 15min; dashboard check if email absent; email delivery is not a guaranteed incident response
runbooks: drain/reconcile ingest DLQ after fixing cause
reconcile ambiguous tool outcome by existing key; no blind write
stop rollout and restore compatible config pointer on regression
details.delivery: bounded exporter retry; alarm on telemetry loss, never equate absent data with health; no lossless guarantee

summary.en: Treat each named external system as one opaque bounded context with an explicit upstream contract.
summary.zh: 将各具名外部系统视为单一不透明限界上下文，并明确上游契约。

X-idp.pattern: OHS/PL upstream; assistant conformist for token semantics

X-model.pattern: OHS/PL upstream; assistant conformist for protocol only, never for authorization

details.terminology: DDD ACL means anti-corruption layer; document ACL means access-control list. These are distinct.

summary.en: Confirm the logical entities, tenant-scoped identifiers, data stewardship and classification.
summary.zh: 确认逻辑实体、租户范围标识、数据管理责任及分类。

details.keys: tenant_id + local_id for tenant-owned records; composite foreign keys preserve tenant scope; idempotency tuple tenant/tool/key is unique

storeOwners.DS-app: R-steward accountable; C-api technical custodian; R-operator operates infrastructure without implicit content rights

classification.DS-index: tenant-confidential derived; same source ACL restrictions

details.logicalModel: D1 attributes are illustrative, not a complete migration schema; Chat denotes a conversation aggregate and does not eliminate message/citation records
details.evaluationIsolation: tenant-scoped deidentified prefixes and synthetic datasets; no cross-tenant content sharing

summary.en: Use a read-only slice, approved writes and finally gated change promotion as the illustrative rollout order.
summary.zh: 示意实施顺序为只读切片、经审批写入，最后实施变更晋级门禁。

details.journeyOwners: R-steward owns source freshness/access explanation; R-operator owns delivery reliability and status reconciliation UI work without being granted tenant content access
details.notCommitment: journey emotions, opportunities, durations and roadmap ordering are teaching assumptions, not customer research or committed dates

summary.en: Give the Agent logical components stable, unnumbered module names without adding deployed services.
summary.zh: 为 Agent 逻辑组件定义稳定、无序号的模块名，不增加部署服务。

details.modelGateway: logical component within answer_composer; ingestion uses its own scoped model invocation identity
details.codeStatus: illustrative module boundaries, not claims about an existing implementation

summary.en: Assign authenticated internal and external contracts with bounded retries and explicit illustrative capacity targets.
summary.zh: 为内部及外部接口指定认证契约、有界重试和明确的示意容量目标。

details.I-07: workload mTLS identity for C-tools; approval.lookup limited to matching tenant/subject/tool/hash; fresh policy lookup
details.I-08: AWS SigV4 task role restricted to selected Bedrock model and region
details.I-09: mTLS source connector identity plus tenant-aware source ACL export; external contract assumed
details.I-10: C-api SigV4 role with sqs:SendMessage on Q-ingest only
details.I-11: C-ingest SigV4 role with ReceiveMessage/DeleteMessage/ChangeMessageVisibility on Q-ingest; long-poll, no broker push
details.owners: R-operator is internal transport custodian; R-steward accountable for tenant data/approval policy; named external-context teams own their endpoints
details.capacity: illustrative 10 interactive requests/s per tenant, burst 20 for 60s; ingest 1 version/s/tenant; tool writes 1/s/tenant
details.timeouts: internal control calls 5s, model generation 30s, external connector 10s; read retries at most 2 with jitter; never retry an ambiguous write with a new key
details.serviceTarget: internal dependency availability target 99.9% monthly, no contractual SLA or vendor guarantee; failures surface to caller and are measured separately

entityReview.deduplication: No exact-ID or same-abstraction duplicates. Capabilities, stages, processes, roadmap states, work packages and data entities remain distinct from containers/stores.

ownerCorrections.EV-created: X-desk creates the ticket; system-level views may show its returned outcome
